label: Shake Shack UK — kcal found, protein not yet found
notes: UNRESOLVED — per-item PROTEIN not yet found. Shake Shack UK (WordPress, Cloudflare 403s plain requests; fetch_protected/curl_cffi gets through) does publish nutrition PDFs, and I downloaded and READ them: https://www.shakeshack.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Nutritional-Information-Hot-Honey.pdf is a one-page "Nutritional Information May 2026" table whose only numeric column is Calories (e.g. ShackBurger Sgl 549, Chicken Shack 493, Fries 427) — no protein/fat/carbs column at all. https://www.shakeshack.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Shake-Shack-Allergens-Info-May-2026.pdf is a 6-page allergen matrix with no macros. Also enumerated the WP media library (/wp-json/wp/v2/media?search=nutrition|nutritional|calories|allergen|menu|info) — the only nutrition-named assets are the two above plus Calories-Veganuary-26-JD-All-Shacks.pdf; checked /faqs/, /menu/, wp-sitemap.xml and all 49 /menu-item/<product>/ pages (0 occurrences of "protein" or "kcal" on each). This is NOT a claim that Shake Shack UK publishes no protein data — only that I have not located it. NEXT STEPS: their ordering/app platform, and the US shakeshack.com nutrition calculator (which does carry protein) checked for a UK/market switch.
